name: OAuth Web App client secret
description: The client secret of an Adobe Developer Console OAuth Web App (user authentication) credential, held by the application's backend server.

blockers.summary: Pages read state no prefix, alphabet or length for the secret; only an Adobe statement would.
A real secret shape and any p8e- attribution would need an issued credential.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
